messages.subject: Boosting
parts:
Hi All…

 

Firstly, I am really learning a lot from this user group…. Thanks to all those who post.

 

My problem lies with the use of Boosting. I have tried many data sets, and while Rattle allows me to apply decision trees and random foresting to these data sets, it does not allow me to undertake boosting. I have checked the data, and I can see no reason why this should be the case. Perhaps im missing something.

 

Can anyone enlighten me as to why this might be happening?

 

Look forward to hearing from you.

 

Cheers

 

John

messages.subject: Re: Boosting
parts:
Hi Jono,

I'll update the tooltip and help page for this. The Boost option uses "ada" and as per the ada man page

> ?ada

[...] 
‘ada’ is used to fit a variety stochastic boosting models for a binary response

So the Boost option is only available for binary classification (i.e., a categoric target with two levels). I'm guessing your data does not have a binary target.

Regards,
Graham
